name: Orchestra Board
description: A Linear-style board for Orca agent teams: Backlog, In Progress, Under Review and Done, a flow canvas, agents started straight from the board, Jev (TypeSafe) picks for assignee and reviewer, and team and prompt settings.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Orchestra Board: Backlog · In Progress · Under Review

settings.title: Team folder
settings.description: The folder with team.json, agents/, teams/ and tasks/, at the root of the repository the agents work in (for example <repo>/.orca-team). Leave empty to use the folder this plugin sits in.

settings.title: Auto refresh (seconds)
settings.description: The board also refreshes when tasks/, agents/ or teams/ change and when an agent's status changes.

settings.title: Assess cards with Jev automatically
settings.description: When a TypeSafe token is saved, ask Jev about each card whose brief or agents changed.

settings.title: Start a review automatically
settings.description: When an agent the board started reports, Jev picks a reviewer (never the implementer) and the board starts it. You still decide Done.

settings.title: Jev model
settings.description: Model name or alias for TypeSafe System One requests.
